verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a SaaS compliance and case-management platform, so data residency and region selection is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region or residency; the docs cover APIs, attachments, FinCEN filings, exports and workflows, none of which addresses where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
